instruction.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1_chirp'>I want to tell you about my best friend, Amina, who is very trustworthy. She's the kind of person who I can always tell my secrets to... She's also very organised and studies every day because she wants to become a doctor... Amina can be a little picky about food, so I sometimes have to share my lunch with her if she doesn't like hers. But that's okay, because she's supportive and does nice things for me as well... Our favourite thing to do together is to have a picnic and a chat in the park.</voice>
